title: SDD Spec — mcp
content:
## MCP Specification
Agent-facing MCP surface that exposes environment metadata, checks, diffs, and gated mutations while redacting secrets and enforcing least-privilege permissions.

### Acceptance Scenarios
1. GIVEN default agent permissions WHEN the agent calls env_list for development THEN keys and secret flags are returned and all secret values are "[REDACTED]"
2. GIVEN envy.yaml defines environments WHEN the agent calls env_list_environments THEN the configured environment names are returned without secret values
3. GIVEN a schema is declared in envy.yaml WHEN the agent calls env_get_schema THEN types, required flags, defaults, and secret markers are returned with no live secret values
4. GIVEN REDIS_URL and SENTRY_DSN are missing and PORT is non-integer WHEN the agent calls env_check("development") THEN status is invalid with those keys listed under missing/invalid and no secret plaintext is included
5. GIVEN two environments differ WHEN the agent calls env_diff for those environments THEN presence and non-secret value differences are returned; secret values remain redacted
6. GIVEN DATABASE_URL is configured as a secret WHEN the agent calls env_exists("DATABASE_URL") THEN true is returned without revealing the value
7. GIVEN DATABASE_URL is configured WHEN the agent calls env_metadata("DATABASE_URL") THEN key, status, type, secret, source, and value "[REDACTED]" are returned
8. GIVEN default permissions (metadata ✓, read_values ✗, write ✗, delete ✗) WHEN the agent attempts to read a secret plaintext value THEN the call is denied and no secret is returned
9. GIVEN the agent has write on development but not read_values WHEN the agent calls env_set for development.REDIS_URL with a reason THEN either the write applies under policy or an approval request is queued; the response never echoes other secrets
10. GIVEN production write is denied for the agent WHEN the agent calls env_set on a production key THEN the operation is rejected as unauthorized
11. GIVEN the agent lacks delete permission WHEN the agent calls env_delete THEN the operation is rejected and the key remains unchanged
12. GIVEN write is allowed for development WHEN the agent calls env_copy to duplicate a non-secret key within an allowed scope THEN the destination is updated without exposing unrelated secrets
13. GIVEN a valid schema WHEN the agent calls env_generate_example THEN an example env document is produced with keys and non-secret defaults only, never live secret values
14. GIVEN project health issues exist WHEN the agent calls env_doctor THEN structured check results and score are returned with any sensitive findings redacted
15. GIVEN any MCP tool invocation WHEN the call completes THEN an audit record stores actor, tool, affected key/env, timestamp, and result without storing plaintext secrets
